messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R 4.0
parts:
Dear INLA maintainers,

Do you have a timeline for releasing a windows binary of INLA for R 4.0? 

Would it be possible to place an empty PACKAGES file at https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.0/? The standard R installation at our institution points to https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable as one of the repositories. Installing other windows packages currently yields the following error: cannot open URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.0/PACKAGES'

I'm assuming that placing an empty PACKAGES file would solve that error.

Best regards,

Thierry

Havenlaan 88 bus 73, 1000 Brussel
